title: Search: filter by maximum down payment
description: Adds `max_down_eur` to the offer search so customers who do not want to put money down can hide offers with a large down payment. Validated in SearchOffersRequest (0 to 50,000 EUR, integers only); applied as `down_payment_cents <= max * 100`. Tests for the filter and for rejected values.

defects.explanation: The new filter is read straight from the request instead of going into SearchOffersRequest::filters(), so it is not part of OfferCatalog::key(): a search with max_down_eur shares the cache entry of the same search without it, and whichever runs first is served to both.
